label: Night of the Saber-Tooth
text: Something is circling this camp. And nobody by the fire knows it yet. Twelve thousand years ago, the dark belonged to something else. A twig snaps. Then another. The children go quiet. The old hunter stops chewing. He's heard this silence before. Then it hits. Five hundred pounds. Seven-inch fangs. Torches fly. Everyone screams. Everyone runs. The fire scatters, and now it's dark. But running is how you die. One hunter stops. Plants his spear. Then another. Then all of them. Shoulder to shoulder, fire in one hand, stone in the other. The cat circles. It has never seen prey turn around. It lunges. Nobody moves. That's the night the hunted became the hunters.

rewrites.why: Cut. The on-screen text NOBODY SEES IT says this while the first line plays, so the voiceover doesn't have to.

rewrites.after: Fourteen thousand years ago, the dark belonged to something else.
rewrites.why: The latest dated North American Smilodon is about 13,000 years old, so 'twelve thousand' is slightly too late. Fourteen thousand sits inside the overlap with humans. Your 'something else' stays: it's what pulls.

rewrites.after: Prey is supposed to run. Not this time.
rewrites.why: 'It has never seen prey turn around' claims to know this animal's experience. 'Prey is supposed to run' is true of predators in general, and 'Not this time' keeps the turn.

rewrites.after: And now the whole camp is circling it.
rewrites.why: 'That's the night the hunted became the hunters' presents a made-up night as the moment history turned, and humans were hunting long before. The new last line reverses the first one ('circling this camp'), so the cut back to the start reads as one continuous story.

notes: Drop the 4-second title card at the end. It's dead time at the moment the loop should restart, and a black text card is what people swipe on. Put NIGHT OF THE SABER-TOOTH in the YouTube title instead.
Opening on-screen text: NOBODY SEES IT (3 words, replaces THEY DON'T KNOW IT'S THERE at 5). It also stands in for the cut second line.
The montage of sub-second cuts in 0:15–0:26 would need 11+ images, more than one day's free image quota (~7). Seven shots cover the whole script: one day of generation.
Every person is a silhouette seen from behind: the pipeline can't hold faces, so 'faces turning from the fire' becomes the hunters' backs.
Sound design (heartbeat, drums, roar) has no free source in the current pipeline. vidIQ music costs 25 credits; sound effects aren't available.
This isn't a Cosmic Dread topic. It was checked against the Cosmic hard rules as the closest set, since there's no config for a prehistoric niche.
